extractions.value: Rapidly developing anti-amphiphysin positive SPS associated with breast cancer. Initial MRI findings (disc herniations) were misleading and resulted in an unnecessary neurosurgical operation (discectomy). Upper limbs and neck were spared, which is unusual for anti-amphiphysin positive SPS. Plasmapheresis and IVIG were not done due to doubtful results in amphiphysin Ab-associated SPS.
